components.name: FlightController
components.responsibility: Executes core flight navigation, avoidance manoeuvres, and contingency responses.

components.name: PerceptionSystem
components.responsibility: Processes environmental sensors to detect obstacles and determine spatial positioning.

components.name: PayloadMechanism
components.responsibility: Manages the physical retention and release of the transport payload.

components.name: CommunicationSystem
components.responsibility: Maintains the encrypted bidirectional RF link with the GCS for telemetry and commands.

components.name: PowerSystem
components.responsibility: Provides electrical power and monitors battery state-of-charge.

components.name: PropulsionSystem
components.responsibility: Generates thrust and maintains controlled flight under commanded manoeuvres.

components.name: SafetyMonitor
components.responsibility: Independently monitors critical subsystem health and enforces fail-safe overrides.

components.name: RecoverySystem
components.responsibility: Deploys the ballistic recovery parachute upon critical failure.

components.name: Airframe
components.responsibility: Provides the structural enclosure and mounting points for all subsystems.
